strings.above_nyquist: %.0f Hz is above the receiver's Nyquist limit of %.0f Hz
strings.blocks_timed_out: %d block%s timed out on the way to the DMA buffer.
strings.bus.help: Initialize I2S and start its clocks
strings.bus_initialized: I2S initialized on BCLK=%d, WS=%d, DOUT=%d
strings.bus_rate_fixed: The I2S bus is already running at %lu Hz
strings.bus_rate_fixed_note: Capture and playback share one rate; re-run 'audio bus ... rate %d' to change both.
strings.capture.help: Record to sequential SD files at 48 kHz, 10 s rollover
strings.capture_out_of_memory: Out of memory for capture buffer
strings.captured: Captured %llu frames at %lu Hz from %s, %u-bit (full scale %.0f)
strings.clipped: Clipped: %llu left, %llu right -- the input is overdriven and every level above is a floor, not a measurement.
strings.close.help: Detach the codec and release I2S
strings.codecs.help: List the parts this firmware can drive
strings.din_invalid: DIN must be a valid pin number, not '%s'
strings.din_invalid_pin: DIN: GPIO %d is not a valid pin on this chip
strings.duration_range: Duration must be greater than 0 and at most %.0f seconds
strings.frequency_not_a_number: Frequency must be a number, not '%s'
strings.frequency_range: %s must be between %.0f Hz and %.0f Hz (half the sample rate)
strings.group.help: Audio over I2S: tone, sweep, microphone capture and loopback testing
strings.info.help: Show pins, format, clocks and the attached codec
strings.info_clocks_no_mclk: , MCLK not routed to a pin
strings.info_no_codec: Codec:   none attached (a bare I2S DAC, amplifier or microphone needs none)
strings.input_i2s: Input:   I2S on DIN=%d at %lu Hz, %u-bit
strings.input_i2s_internal: Input:   I2S on DIN=%d at %lu Hz, %u-bit -- looped back inside the chip, nothing external
strings.input_none: Input:   none. Add 'din <pin>' to 'audio bus', or run 'audio pdm <clk> <data>'.
strings.input_pdm: Input:   PDM on CLK=%d, DATA=%d, decimated to %lu Hz 16-bit
strings.input_pdm_clock_range: Outside the 1-3.25 MHz most MEMS microphones specify; try another rate if it reads silent.
strings.level_range: Level must be 1-100 percent of full scale
strings.loopback.help: Play a tone and measure whether the input hears it
strings.loopback_heard: Heard it: %.0f Hz rose %.1f dB in the %s slot when the output started.
strings.loopback_internal_note: Internal loopback, so this proves the transmit and capture paths and nothing outside them.
strings.loopback_intro: Testing whether the input hears %.0f Hz at %d%% from the output.
strings.loopback_marginal: Marginal: %.0f Hz rose only %.1f dB -- something is getting through, but not a working path.
strings.loopback_not_heard: Not heard: %.0f Hz did not rise when the output started.
strings.loopback_note: DIN and DOUT are the same pin, so 'audio record' sees the transmitter through the pad and nothing external.
strings.loopback_try: Try in order: 'audio tone %.0f 3', 'audio record', then 'audio loopback %.0f level 80'.
strings.mclk_invalid: MCLK must be an output-capable pin, not '%s'
strings.monitor_header: RMS per slot, ten times a second for %.0f s. Bars run from -80 dBFS to 0.
strings.no_codec_mute: No codec attached, so there is nothing to mute
strings.no_codec_note: Run 'audio codecs' for the parts this firmware knows, then attach one (for example 'audio-nau8822 init').
strings.no_codec_volume: No codec attached, so there is nothing to set the volume on
strings.no_dout: The bus has no DOUT pin, so there is nothing to play
strings.no_i2s: %s has no I2S peripheral, so audio cannot be tested on it
strings.no_receiver: Nothing is set up to receive audio
strings.no_receiver_note: Add a receive line to the I2S bus ('audio bus <bclk> <ws> <dout> din <pin>'), or open a PDM microphone ('audio pdm <clk> <data>').
strings.no_volume_note: Use the digital level instead: 'audio tone 1000 3 level 10'.

not_initialized.text: I2S not initialized. Run 'audio bus <bclk> <ws> <dout>' first.

strings.pdm_clk_invalid: CLK: GPIO %d is not an output-capable pin on this chip
strings.pdm_data_invalid: DATA: GPIO %d is not a valid pin on this chip
strings.pdm_next_step: Run 'audio record' to see what it hears.
strings.pdm_no_filter: %s can clock a PDM microphone but has no PDM-to-PCM filter
strings.pdm_no_filter_note: The raw bitstream would need decimating in software before any of it means anything, which this firmware does not do. An I2S microphone on 'audio bus ... din <pin>' works here.
strings.pdm_pin_conflict: GPIO %d is already the I2S %s, so it cannot also be the microphone's %s
strings.pdm_pin_conflict_note: They share a pin here, so the microphone and the speaker cannot both run. Run 'audio close', or 'audio pdm' on the microphone's own pins.
strings.pdm_pins_distinct: CLK and DATA cannot both be GPIO %d
strings.pdm_pins_numeric: CLK and DATA must be pin numbers
strings.pdm_released: The PDM microphone was released; re-run 'audio pdm' to bring it back at the new rate.
strings.pin_not_output_capable: %s: GPIO %d is not an output-capable pin on this chip
strings.pins_numeric: BCLK, WS and DOUT must be pin numbers
strings.playing_continuously: Playing continuously. Enter 'audio stop' to end it.
strings.record.help: Capture the input and report levels and a spectrum
strings.sd_not_mounted: SD card not mounted at /sd. Run 'sd spi' or 'sd mmc' first.
strings.short_reads: %d read%s came up short; the receiver overran and samples were lost.
strings.silence_note: Transmitting silence, so the clocks are live for the codec.
strings.slot_stuck: The %s slot never changed -- all %llu samples read %ld. Check the part is clocked and the data pin is the right one.
strings.spectrum_header: Power per half octave, %llu frames analysed (%.1f Hz bins)
strings.spectrum_note: Bars run from %.0f dBFS to 0; the figure on the right is dBFS.
strings.sweep.help: Sweep a sine tone between two frequencies
strings.sweep_freqs_numeric: Start and end frequencies must be numbers
strings.sweep_freqs_same: Start and end frequencies are the same; use 'audio tone' for that
strings.task_start_failed: Could not start the playback task
strings.task_stop_timeout: Playback task did not stop within 2 s
strings.too_short_to_measure: Too short to measure the rate; the run barely outlasts the DMA buffer.
strings.unexpected_argument_pdm: Unexpected argument '%s'; the only option is 'rate <hz>'
strings.volume.help: Show or set the codec's output volume
strings.volume_unset: Volume has not been set this session.
